notes.title: Demo Update #2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We’ve just pushed a new update for the demo with a bunch of fixes and improvements, thanks again for all your feedback and reports 🙏

Fixes & Improvements

Adjusted headbobbing for smoother movement

Fixed hole in reserve floor

Fixed issue where unlimited unpainted miniatures could be placed

Added on-screen message when incorrect amounts are entered in credit card transactions

Fixed drop boxes appearing inside walls

Attempted fix for card machine problem at the cash register

Fixed dice being unclickable on the cash register

Corrected shelf scaling (now 1.1)

As always, we really appreciate your help in making the game better. Keep sharing your feedback and have fun running your shop! 🎲

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello Shopkeepers!  
In the past few days, we’ve rolled out small but important patches to keep your shop running smoothly. A few issues have been fixed so you can focus on stocking shelves, serving customers, and building your dream tabletop game shop!
Patch Notes
Fixed cash register UI going off-screen in German.

Fixed Simplified Chinese characters.

Fixed being stuck in crouch when loading a save.

Fixed various bug with the cash register.

Fixed being able to pay your bills without having enough money.

Fixed collection window closing when pressing ‘C’ while typing in a text field.

Fixed incorrect amounts being displayed when using the cash register.

Significantly improved performances for most PCs, please let us know if lags are still experienced. 

Thanks for your continued feedback :)


It really helps us make the game better every day. 

Happy collecting, and see you in the shop!

The Tabletop Game Shop Sim Team

notes.title: Playtest Major Update & Demo Launch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just rolled out a fresh update for the Tabletop Game Shop Simulator playtests! This patch brings in lots of new features, some quality-of-life improvements, and a bunch of balancing tweaks to make your shopkeeping journey even more satisfying.

As always, we also fixed a ton of bugs you reported to us. Thank you so much for your help and support! 😄

But that’s not all...
A Big Announcement!
We’re thrilled to announce that Tabletop Game Shop Simulator will have a public demo as part of the Steam Debut Festival, starting August 7!

We can’t wait to open the doors of the shop to even more players, and we’d love your help in spreading the word!
New Content
Added light head bobbing when walking for extra immersion

You can now crouch (because hey, it’s fun)

A first light tutorial now introduces the main mechanics

New display stands let you showcase your favorite figurines and admire them whenever you like

Posters are now manually placed so you can decorate your shop your way

Added Forge of War banners for extra shop flair

Added visual variations for the painting and wargame tables. Let us know what you think!

The game now supports gamepad controls

More store extensions have been added to expand your kingdom of nerdiness

The game is now available in German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese

Added a few new figurines to collect and display

The reserve can now be opened when reading level 16!

Added painting animations
Balancing Tweaks
Adjusted the effects of some figurines in Wargame gameplay

Reworked customer behavior. How they enter and exit the store, and what they buy, should now feel more natural

Updated movement speed for a better overall feel

Revised scoring for the painting mini-game to better reflect your performance

We’re getting closer and closer to the full experience, and your feedback is shaping the future of the game in real time. So please keep sharing your thoughts, suggestions, and bug reports. We’re listening, and we’re building this with you 💛

Thanks again for playing, and happy shopkeeping!

The Tabletop Game Shop Sim Team

notes.title: Playtests Update#1
notes.notes:
Hello Shop Owners!

Thank you so much for joining the first playtests of Tabletop Game Shop Simulator! Your feedback has been incredibly helpful, and we’ve been hard at work addressing issues, improving the experience, and adding exciting new content. Here’s what’s new in this 0.11.6 update:


🛠 Fixes
Fixed a loading bug that occurred when figurines were in a customer’s bag or on the cash register.

Fixed an issue where display stand figurines would disappear after loading a save. This should solve most of the save loading issues you encountered!

Fixed blocked interactions caused by certain figurines.

Fixed a bug preventing the player from ending the day after loading a save at the end-of-day phase.

Fixed input issues with non-French keyboards.

Fixed the cursor disappearing during the end-of-day and shop phases.

✨ Content
Added new figurines: Demon, Bone Wardens, Banner Bearer, Hellas, The Scarlet Count, and Heneria, the Celestial Voice.

Added visual effects for the Wargame.

Added a rough version of key remapping.

Added the possibility to visualize the miniatures pieces you're missing

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601717/d8053203992391d6a8101d70039ea69acc1f296f.png"]
⚖️ Balancing
Increased customer movement speed.

Increased player movement speed.

Improved customer purchasing logic.

Updated Wargame skill values.

Updated figurine rarity formulas.

XP gain rebalanced: leveling up is now easier.

Day cycle length increased from 10 to 12 minutes.

Improved customer AI: higher chance of playing together.

Reduced starting money.



Thanks again for all your feedback and support, it’s helping us shape the game into something truly special. We hope you enjoy this update, and we can’t wait to hear what you think!

Happy shopkeeping,


The Tabletop Game Shop Team

notes.title: Dev Update June 2025
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re back with a quick update on Tabletop Game Shop Simulator development, things are moving fast, and we’re super excited about how the project is evolving.


Bringing Our NPCs to Life
One of the biggest challenges lately has been getting our customers to feel real. Animating NPCs in a way that makes them expressive, believable, and fun to watch has taken a lot of iteration, but we’re finally at a place we’re proud of!

Below is a little GIF showing how far we’ve come. We think it really brings the shop to life.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601717/8578bc71a06f395521c7b44297b4a3fe9209aa4b.gif"]

Let us know what you think, your feedback helps us keep improving!


Introducing... The Wargame!
We’ve also been working on one of the most exciting parts of the game, the Wargame system.

Yes, you read that right: not only will you sell miniatures, you’ll also be able to play with them, against your customers!

We now have a solid, satisfying gameplay loop in place for these battles, with cool rules, tactical choices, and some surprises. This is a big step toward making the shop feel like a real hobby hub.

We’ll share more details in a dedicated post soon but trust us, if you’ve ever dreamed of slamming down a painted mini and yelling “It’s go time!”, you’re gonna love it.

In the meantime, here’s a sneak peek at what it looked like when we first started working on it… and what it looks like now.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601717/eee1caaf7c6358e1d18802886ed65ca69eeab88f.gif"]

Ho and also, we have a very cool dice animation =)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601717/6ec2b0c37c4bcd5d005f9a579da17719a3b11c29.gif"]



That’s it for now! Thanks again for following us. If you haven’t already, don’t forget to wishlist the game, it helps a lot, especially during this phase.

Talk soon!
The Tabletop Game Shop Simulator team
